researchDraft.querySummary: Research date 2026-08-25. The dossier contains six candidate signals spanning Iran financial blockade, Fed AI credit risk, NVIDIA power/land investments, gas-turbine supply bottlenecks, Alibaba AI equity placement, and U.S. data-center political backlash. Each signal was assessed for process fit and scored.

en.title: US 'Economic D-Day' against Iran raises dollar weaponization and oil-supply risk
en.coreFact: On Aug 24, Treasury Secretary Bessent announced Operation Economic Outcast, blacklisting 60+ entities and threatening to expel any money launderer from the dollar system; Iran responded by threatening to halt all oil exports and again raised Hormuz closure.
en.whyItMatters: The move links oil security to financial infrastructure, not just military access, and adds digital assets and secondary sanctions to enforcement. Calm oil prices suggest markets are pricing low war risk; a Hormuz closure would upend supply assumptions.
en.processMatchReason: Fits energy-security process where reliable access decides strategic capacity, but shows the instrument shifting from physical supply to financial exclusion.

zh.title: 美国对伊朗发动“经济D日”全面金融封锁，石油与美元武器化同步升级
zh.coreFact: 8月24日，美国财长贝森特宣布启动“Operation Economic Outcast”，黑名单覆盖全球60多个实体、个人和船只，并警告将把为德黑兰洗钱的实体永久剔除出美元体系；伊朗回应威胁停止全部石油出口，继续以封锁霍尔木兹海峡为筹码。
zh.whyItMatters: 金融封锁将石油安全与全球支付基础设施直接挂钩，制裁范围扩展至数字资产和次级制裁。原油市场反应平静，显示市场对全面战争定价较低；一旦霍尔木兹海峡真正关闭，能源供应假设将发生根本改变。
zh.processMatchReason: 该事件契合能源安全进程的逻辑，但显示“可靠能源获取”的手段正从军事干预和实物供应转向美元体系与金融制裁，重构战略容量的决定因素。

en.title: Fed minutes formally flag AI capex credit risk as financial-stability issue
en.coreFact: July FOMC minutes show officials warning that AI-related valuations rely on very optimistic long-term earnings and that rising AI capex is increasingly financed by borrowing from non-bank investors and regional banks.
en.whyItMatters: This marks the first central-bank-level linkage between AI infrastructure spending and credit-system vulnerability. Combined with Warsh's upcoming Jackson Hole speech and failed Treasury buybacks, the cost and availability of capital for AI buildout become a live systemic variable.
en.processMatchReason: Matches macro-financial-stability process by turning AI capex from an equity story into a credit exposure, while also constraining AI-infrastructure finance.

zh.title: 美联储纪要首次将AI资本开支信贷风险列入金融稳定议题
zh.coreFact: 7月FOMC纪要显示，官员们警告AI相关企业高估值建立在长期盈利乐观预期上，一旦大幅下修可能引发广泛资产重估；少数官员指出AI资本开支越来越依赖非银投资者和地区银行的借款融资。
zh.whyItMatters: 这是央行层面首次把AI基础设施支出与信用体系风险正式挂钩。叠加Warsh的Jackson Hole演讲和财政部回购托市失效，长端利率与AI融资成本已成为AI建设可持续性的关键变量。
zh.processMatchReason: 符合宏观金融稳定进程：AI资本开支从股权估值问题转化为信贷风险来源，并开始约束AI基础设施的融资空间。

sources.title: Tonghuashun/Koufu transcript of FOMC minutes
Seattle Times: Fed minutes and AI risks

Reuters via Finance-Commerce: market awaits Warsh Jackson Hole

en.title: NVIDIA shifts from chip seller to owner of power, land and project guarantees
en.coreFact: NVIDIA confirmed strategic investment in Lancium (15GW pipeline), took a stake in Cloverleaf Infrastructure, invested $1.5B in SB Energy, and guaranteed up to $105B in lease payments for OpenAI's 8GW Ohio campus.
en.whyItMatters: The AI infrastructure race is now capital- and power-integrated: the dominant chipmaker is using equity, guarantees and securitization to lock capacity in electricity, land and construction, exposing its balance sheet to delivery risk.
en.processMatchReason: Directly alters ai-infrastructure-race process by moving NVIDIA from upstream supplier to co-developer/guarantor of gigawatt-scale projects, changing who bears execution risk.

zh.title: 英伟达从芯片供应商转为电力、土地与项目担保的所有者
zh.coreFact: 8月25日确认英伟达对Lancium进行战略投资，推进超过15GW的AI工厂组合；此前已入股Cloverleaf、投资SB Energy 15亿美元，并为OpenAI俄亥俄州8GW园区提供最高1050亿美元租赁支付担保。
zh.whyItMatters: AI基础设施竞赛进入资本-电力一体化阶段：英伟达通过股权、担保和资产证券化把资产负债表直接押进电力、土地、建设与融资环节，以所有权锁定大规模容量，承担项目交付风险。
zh.processMatchReason: 改变了AI基础设施竞赛进程的结构：芯片主导者从上游供应商变成吉瓦级项目的共同开发者和担保人，容量锁定方式从销售芯片转向持有资产与信用背书。

en.title: Gas-turbine manufacturing becomes the new physical bottleneck for AI capacity
en.coreFact: GE Vernova reported 116GW of gas-power backlog and slot agreements at end-Q2, up from 83GW at end-2025; Morgan Stanley noted only about three foundries worldwide can cast large turbine hot-end components.
en.whyItMatters: AI's gigawatt-scale power demand now depends on turbine casting capacity, repeating the equipment/materials choke point seen in semiconductors. Project timelines for NVIDIA/OpenAI campuses are constrained by orders already booked into the 2030s.
en.processMatchReason: Extends energy-security process from fuel supply to generating-equipment manufacturing, making reliable power capacity a function of casting and turbine backlog.

zh.title: 燃气轮机成为AI算力新瓶颈：116GW积压订单与仅约3家热端部件铸造厂
zh.coreFact: GE Vernova二季度末燃气发电设备积压订单及槽位协议达116GW（2025年底为83GW）；摩根士丹利指出全球仅约3家铸造厂能生产大型涡轮机热端部件。
zh.whyItMatters: AI数据中心用电占比预期到2028-2030年升至约8.5%，而发电设备制造已排满至2030年代。瓶颈从芯片、电力下探到涡轮机铸造产能，形成类似半导体的设备-材料卡脖子逻辑。
zh.processMatchReason: 将能源安全进程从燃料供应延伸至发电设备制造环节：可靠电力容量不再只取决于能源资源，而受制于涡轮机铸造与积压订单。

sources.title: Yahoo Finance: GE Vernova backlog reaches 116GW
Morgan Stanley report via Gate News: turbine casting bottleneck

en.title: Alibaba raises $10.2B in AI-dedicated placement, sovereign funds buy in despite U.S. controls
en.coreFact: Alibaba priced 710 million new shares at HK$112.70, raising HK$80B (~$10.2B) under Regulation S; 100% of net proceeds will go to full-stack AI and AI infrastructure, with Middle East, European and Asian sovereign wealth funds among subscribers.
en.whyItMatters: A single $10B+ deal shows global sovereign capital is still willing to bet on Chinese AI even as U.S. technology controls tighten, partially countering the idea that controls isolate China's AI from capital. The 8% share drop also highlights dilution costs of the AI financing cycle.
en.processMatchReason: Adds evidence to global-ai-capital-flows process: capital routing, not technology transfer alone, may determine AI competitiveness; also introduces dilution pressure into AI infrastructure financing.

zh.title: 阿里巴巴完成800亿港元AI配售，主权基金认购显示全球资本仍押注中国AI
zh.coreFact: 阿里巴巴8月24日定价每股112.70港元，配售7.1亿股新股，募资800亿港元（约102亿美元），100%净募资用于全栈AI与AI基础设施；中东、欧洲、亚洲主权财富基金积极认购。
zh.whyItMatters: 在美国科技管制收紧的背景下，全球主权资本仍以百亿美元级规模直接下注中国AI，部分反驳“技术控制导致资本隔离”的判断。股价下跌8%也反映AI股权融资进入“融资-稀释”张力阶段。
zh.processMatchReason: 为全球AI资本流动进程提供新证据：资本流向可能比技术转移更能影响AI竞争力；同时千亿级AI融资的稀释成本开始显性化。

sources.title: Alibaba Group official announcement: HK$80B placement
Reuters via Yahoo/CNBC: Alibaba AI placement pricing

en.title: Data-center backlash becomes a U.S. political and market risk factor
en.coreFact: Politico describes an 'oh shit moment' as Texas paused new data-center permits, Pennsylvania required community consent, 8 states cut tax subsidies in 2026, 17 more consider it, and 70% of voters oppose local AI data centers; meanwhile the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell over 3% on Aug 24.
en.whyItMatters: The AI infrastructure race now faces a hard political-permission constraint: local approvals, subsidies and voter sentiment can delay gigawatt-scale buildout regardless of capital availability. This coincides with Fed credit warnings and Nvidia's five-day decline before earnings, putting both political and financing assumptions in question.
en.processMatchReason: Adds a new political-license variable to ai-infrastructure-race; previously the process assumed capital sufficiency, but now permit and tax decisions shape reliable large-scale capacity.

zh.title: 数据中心政治反弹升级为中期选举危机，叠加8月24日全球半导体抛售
zh.coreFact: Politico称行业进入“oh shit时刻”：德州暂停新数据中心审批，宾州要求社区同意，2026年已有8州立法削减数据中心税收补贴、17州在考虑；民调显示70%选民反对在本地建设AI数据中心。8月24日费城半导体指数跌超3%，英伟达连跌5日。
zh.whyItMatters: AI基础设施竞赛首次遭遇真正的政治许可约束：地方审批、税收补贴和选民反弹可延迟吉瓦级项目建设，即便资本已经到位。叠加美联储对AI信贷风险的警告，AI基础设施的“政治成本”与“资本可得性”同时进入重估。
zh.processMatchReason: 为AI基础设施竞赛进程引入新的政治许可变量：容量落地速度取决于地方许可、税收优惠和社会接受度，而非仅由资本决定。
